context: Tests whether the agent correctly implements a proposed DLD decision by adding mandatory @decision annotations in source code at declaration level, updating the decision record's references and status, regenerating the index, running annotation verification, and proactively looking up existing @decision annotations before modifying annotated code.

checklist.name: @decision annotation present
checklist.description: Source code (src/processor.py or any new module) contains at least one `# @decision(DL-001)` annotation

checklist.name: Annotation at declaration level
checklist.description: The `@decision(DL-001)` annotation appears on its own comment line immediately before a function or class definition, NOT on a line that also contains code or repeated on every line of the function body

checklist.name: Bare annotation (no rationale restatement)
checklist.description: The `@decision(DL-001)` annotation line does NOT include an inline explanation or paraphrase of the decision rationale (e.g., no '# @decision(DL-001) — because we validate input' or '# @decision(DL-001) use validate_input for safety')

checklist.name: DL-001 references populated
checklist.description: The `references` field in `decisions/records/DL-001.md` YAML frontmatter is non-empty and contains at least one path entry pointing to the annotated source file

checklist.name: INDEX.md updated
checklist.description: `decisions/INDEX.md` shows DL-001 with `status: accepted` (regenerated after the status update)

checklist.name: validate_input function created
checklist.description: A `validate_input` function (or equivalent callable) exists in the source code that checks for required fields and raises a `ValueError` with a descriptive message when validation fails

checklist.name: process_data calls validate_input first
checklist.description: `process_data` calls `validate_input` (or equivalent) as its first statement before any transformation logic executes

checklist.name: Verification script run
checklist.description: `steps.md` mentions running `.tessl/skills/dld-implement/scripts/verify-annotations.sh DL-001` (or equivalent) and includes its output or outcome

checklist.name: DL-000 looked up before modifying processor
checklist.description: `steps.md` explicitly mentions reading or looking up decision DL-000 before modifying `src/processor.py`, because the file contained a `@decision(DL-000)` annotation
